name: Cash - Operating Checking
description: The bank account being imported. Never assign this as a category.

name: Savings Account
description: Transfers between the operating checking account and the business's own savings account (in either direction).

name: Equipment
description: Computers, monitors, furniture and other equipment costing over $1,000 with a multi-year life.

name: Accumulated Depreciation
description: Year-end adjustment only.

name: Loan Payable
description: Scheduled payments on a business loan (bank or SBA). The ledger splits each payment into principal and interest.

name: Owner's Capital
description: Opening owner's capital.

name: Owner Contributions
description: Money the owner deposits into the business from personal funds.

name: Owner Draws
description: Money the owner takes out: transfers to the owner's personal accounts, and the owner's personal income tax payments (IRS or state estimated taxes) for a pass-through LLC.

name: Retained Earnings
description: Accumulated profit from prior years.

name: Service Revenue
description: Customer payments: client ACH credits, incoming wires, Stripe/Square/PayPal payouts, deposited checks from clients.

name: Interest Income
description: Interest paid by the bank on account balances.

name: Wages
description: Employee net pay (e.g. payroll provider NET PAY debits).

name: Payroll Taxes
description: Payroll tax remittances made through the payroll provider or EFTPS.

name: Contractors
description: Payments to freelancers and independent contractors (Zelle/ACH to individuals with an invoice memo, Upwork, Fiverr).

name: Rent
description: Office or studio rent.

name: Utilities
description: Electricity, gas, water, internet and business phone service.

name: Software & Subscriptions
description: SaaS and software subscriptions (Adobe, Google Workspace, Slack, Figma, Zoom, QuickBooks, Apple iCloud).

name: Cloud Hosting
description: Infrastructure: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Vercel, DigitalOcean.

name: Office Supplies
description: Small office purchases (Amazon Marketplace, Staples, Office Depot) and their refunds. Refunds are positive amounts in this same category.

name: Advertising & Marketing
description: Google Ads, Meta/Facebook ads, LinkedIn ads and job posts, sponsorships, promotional printing.

name: Travel
description: Airfare, hotels, rental cars, rideshare/taxi rides (Uber trips, Lyft) and parking.

name: Meals
description: Restaurants, coffee shops and food delivery (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub).

name: Insurance
description: Business insurance premiums (general liability, professional liability, property).

name: Professional Fees
description: Accountants/CPAs, lawyers, legal filing services, and payroll processing fees.

name: Bank & Merchant Fees
description: Bank account maintenance fees, wire fees, overdraft fees, card processing fees billed separately.

name: Interest Expense
description: Computed by the ledger from loan payments.

name: Depreciation Expense
description: Year-end adjustment computed by the ledger.

name: Uncategorized
description: Use ONLY when the transaction cannot be identified from its description (e.g. a bare check number or an unexplained personal payment app transfer). It is sent for human review.
